sentences.text:
Heard Sri. Nizam Abbas, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, Sri. Rangaswamy R.,
learned HCGP appearing for respondent No.1, Sri. P.C. Narasimaiah, learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 and have perused the material on record.
3.
During the pendency of these proceedings, it transpires that the parties to the lis have entered into a settlement and have placed on record such settlement along with the joint affidavit.

Terms of settlement reads as follows:
"JOINT AFFIDAVIT We, (i) MOHAMMED GHANI, aged 33 years, S/o S A Noor,
No.383, Chamundi Nagar, Muninanjappa Block, RT Nagar Post, Bangalore- 560032.

(ii) SA NOOR, aged 80 years, S/o Late Shaik Ahmed, No.383, Chamundi Nagar,
Muninanjappa Block, RT Nagar Post, Bangalore-560032 NC: 2024:KHC:44559 (iii) JAVEEDA BANU, aged 62 years, W/o S A Noor, No.383, Chamundi Nagar,
Muninanjappa Block, RT Nagar Post, Bangalore-560032 (iv) ISHRATHUNNISSA,
aged 32 years D/o Mr. Syed Riyaz, Residing at No.318, Venkateshamappa Layout,
Chamundi Nagar, RT Nagar Post, Bangalore 32, do hereby solemnly affirm on oath as follows;
1. That, we, are the petitioner and the respondent No.2 in the above petition and conversant with the facts deposed to herein.
2. That, we, have amicably compromised the matter and settled our disputes, and filed the accompanying application for the compromise of the matter, and in view of the same the continuation of the proceedings are not necessary.
Wherefore, we, pray, that, this Hon'ble court may be pleased to Quash the entire proceedings against the petitioners, (accused No.1 to 3) in CC No.54496/2020, (Crime No.89/2020) registered for the offences under section 498 (A), 504, 324 r/w section 34 of Indian Penal Code by the DJ Halli Police Station, Bangalore pending on the file of The Court of the XI Addl. Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Bangalore and to pass such other and further order/s as this Hon'ble court may deem fit and proper in the circumstances of the case in the interest of justice.
It is our name, our signature and the contents of the above para 1 and 2 are true and correct to the best of our knowledge, belief and information."
4. In the light of application for compounding being filed along with the joint affidavit and offences not being against the State, I deem it appropriate to accept the compounding application and terminate the proceedings against the petitioners in the subject petition.
NC: 2024:KHC:44559 5.

For the aforesaid reasons, the following:

3 ORDER i.
